purpose: Recognize an approach appropriate to someone’s own circumstances.
keywords: N / plain form + なりに; N + なりの + N
The child is thinking through the reasons in their own way.
I reached an answer of my own.
We make the best of living in a small space.
formation: N / plain form + なりに; N + なりの + N
restrictions: Often acknowledges effort despite limited ability or resources.
mistake: It does not necessarily mean doing something poorly.
